title: Cold derivation of XML keys A0003-A0010 for library-specialty
body:
## Goal
Derive, cold, the literal XML values at eight given locators of one public artifact and save them as a key file. This is the step-1 recommendation of `benchmark/challenges/next-gap-0202.md` (`## Recommendation`). Report, do not fix: you compare nothing and edit no other file.
Expected gain: XML key confirmation for `library-specialty` goes from 2 of 10 to 10 of 10 IDs once a later checker compares your file. The next shaper reads `benchmark/challenges/positive-control-key-0203.json`.
No session can run LabVIEW. Claim XML text facts only, never LabVIEW behaviour, resolution or meaning.

## Acceptance
- [ ] `benchmark/challenges/positive-control-key-0203.json` exists and parses as JSON, with keys `artifact_path` (the path below), `artifact_sha256` (lowercase sha256 of the bytes you read) and `claims`.
- [ ] `claims` holds exactly the IDs A0003 to A0010, each an object with `claim_id`, `locator` (the expression given below, unchanged), `value` (exact ElementTree-parsed string, no stripping or normalisation; record whitespace as is), `line` (1-based line of the element in the file) and `derivation` (one sentence: how you got the value).
- [ ] You did not open any forbidden file listed in `## Budget`; the report states this explicitly and lists every file you read.
- [ ] `git status --porcelain` shows only the new key file (no `__pycache__`, no other change).

## Verification
`python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('benchmark/challenges/positive-control-key-0203.json')); assert d['artifact_sha256']=='83bd104933f209b839fa8438fbff3e380f6a5ad2e7289e76cb6c38dd1a6287d0', d['artifact_sha256']; ids=sorted(c['claim_id'] for c in d['claims']); assert ids==['A00%02d' % i for i in range(3,11)], ids; assert all({'claim_id','locator','value','line','derivation'} <= set(c) for c in d['claims']); print('key 0203: OK')"`

## Context
- Artifact: `$LABVIEW_ENVIRONMENT/actor-framework/Core/ActorFramework/AF Specialty Messages.lvlib` (in Read/Grep: `@environment/actor-framework/Core/ActorFramework/AF Specialty Messages.lvlib`). Read-only; run any python3 that reads it with `-I -B`, scripts outside the environment directory.
- Locators (XPath-positional, 1-based index among same-name children of the parent; `text()` means the element's ElementTree `.text`):
  - A0003 `/Library/Property[4]/@Type`
  - A0004 `/Library/Property[4]/text()`
  - A0005 `/Library/Item[1]/@Name`
  - A0006 `/Library/Item[1]/@Type`
  - A0007 `/Library/Item[1]/@URL`
  - A0008 `/Library/Item[2]/@Name`
  - A0009 `/Library/Item[2]/@Type`
  - A0010 `/Library/Item[2]/@URL`
- If a locator does not resolve, set `value` to null and say why in `derivation`; do not guess.
- Role tools: a message "No such tool available: Read. Read is disabled for this session" is the CLI refusing a native tool; propose the same operation as a broker JSON action. It is not a block.
- Do not run `git commit`; the parent commits.

## Budget
- Read only: the artifact above and this task. Write only the key file.
- Forbidden (they hold the expected values): `benchmark/challenges/positive-control-key-0191.json`, `benchmark/cases/dev/*.json`, `benchmark/challenges/next-gap-0202.md`, `benchmark/challenges/plan-0189*`, `benchmark/challenges/README.md`, `benchmark/scripts/**`, `benchmark/results/**`, `journal/**`, any history or report file.
- Short command output; report within 25 turns.

title: Stdlib checker: XML keys vs artifact and vs library-specialty inventory
body:
## Goal
Write `benchmark/challenges/check_xml_keys.py` (step 2 of `benchmark/challenges/next-gap-0202.md` `## Recommendation`) and run it on the cold keys `positive-control-key-0191.json` and `positive-control-key-0203.json`. Report, do not fix: any disagreement between a key, the artifact and the inventory is reported with ID, both values and locator; never edit a key file or the fixture to reconcile.
Expected gain: a repeatable command showing whether all ten XML IDs (A0001-A0010) of `benchmark/cases/dev/library-specialty.json` are independently confirmed. The next shaper reads the report's agreement line and the script.
No session can run LabVIEW; this checks XML text only. It does not close the #831 citation-check gap.

## Acceptance
- [ ] `benchmark/challenges/check_xml_keys.py` uses only the Python standard library. It accepts key files as positional arguments plus `--artifact PATH` and/or `--inventory FIXTURE`. It reads the claim field names of both key files as they actually are (Read `positive-control-key-0191.json` first; the two files may differ in shape).
- [ ] `--artifact`: checks the artifact sha256 against each key's `artifact_sha256` and that each claim's value equals the ElementTree-parsed text at its locator (1-based positional; `text()` = `.text`).
- [ ] `--inventory`: for each key claim, compares value and locator with the fixture's `reference_inventory` entry of the same `claim_id` (`atomic_fact.value`, `citations[0].locator.expression`).
- [ ] On full agreement it prints `xml keys: N/N OK` and exits 0; otherwise it prints every mismatch and exits 1. Both modes run; the report quotes their output.
- [ ] Mutation check: a copy of one key with one literal altered, saved under `.session/artifacts/`, makes each mode exit 1; quote the output.
- [ ] `git status --porcelain` lists only the new script (no `__pycache__`); no file listed in `benchmark/writing/input-pins.json` changed (`git diff --stat` on main paths).

## Verification
`python3 -B -I benchmark/challenges/check_xml_keys.py --inventory benchmark/cases/dev/library-specialty.json benchmark/challenges/positive-control-key-0191.json benchmark/challenges/positive-control-key-0203.json`

## Context
- Artifact: `$LABVIEW_ENVIRONMENT/actor-framework/Core/ActorFramework/AF Specialty Messages.lvlib` (Read/Grep: `@environment/actor-framework/...`), sha256 `83bd104933f209b839fa8438fbff3e380f6a5ad2e7289e76cb6c38dd1a6287d0`. Engine verification has no environment, so the verification uses `--inventory` only; run `--artifact` yourself.
- Import nothing from `benchmark/scripts/`; always `python3 -B -I` (#785).
- Role tools: a message "No such tool available: Read. Read is disabled for this session" is the CLI refusing a native tool; propose the same operation as a broker JSON action. It is not a block.
- Do not run `git commit`; the parent commits. Long inline one-liners stall (#743): write the script to a file.

## Budget
- Read: `benchmark/challenges/positive-control-key-0191.json`, `benchmark/challenges/positive-control-key-0203.json`, `benchmark/cases/dev/library-specialty.json` (keys `reference_inventory` only via python3, not whole), the artifact, `benchmark/writing/input-pins.json` (key list only).
- Do not read `score.py`, `benchmark/results/**`, history or journal. Short outputs; report early.
